implementation.summary: McpDispatcher.handle is a pure suspend String -> String? over the injected AnnotationHandoff. Outer frame always serialized with compact Json (the inner document uses prettyPrint but rides as an escaped string value, satisfying the one-line stdout guard). Root is passed explicitly to fileSlotAnnotationHandoff(root) so the logged path is provably the path read.

troubleshooting.issue: Accepted deviation from the task prose, which specified runBlocking: main is a suspend fun main() instead, because kotlinx-coroutines-core is only a transitive RUNTIME dep of :data-handoff-api and never on :mcp-application's compile classpath. Adding it would violate the 'envelope + serialization only' constraint that the server's spawn-time budget rests on. :desktop-application's own Main.kt avoids coroutine imports for the identical reason. Tests use a ~15-line stdlib-only runSuspendBlocking bridge rather than pulling in kotlinx-coroutines-test.
troubleshooting.resolution: Accepted - the binding constraint outranks the illustrative prose
